summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 (Unified Node Codec Core Keystone) — replacing legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata types with a unified Node codec featuring dual-sealed bodies and generation-based AAD, plus a cascade of consumer compile-gate migrations across core/sdk-core/sdk/web.
summary.outcome: Planning completed in full (9 plans / 7 waves, research + validation + pattern-map + 15-dimension plan-check all passed after one revision round). Execution progressed through Wave 5 (62-07 sdk compile-gate), with Waves 6–7 (web compile-gates) still pending when the transcript ended.

repo: Consumer test files that import retired types fail tsc BEFORE `describe.skip` evaluates — imports must be removed outright, not just test bodies skipped.

`file-ipns.test.ts` tested retired FilePointer/FolderMetadata code via `../file/derive-ipns` and `../file/metadata` — not the live `ipns/` module, which has its own separate passing tests (`ipns.test.ts`, `ipns-record.test.ts`).
Retired type names appearing in core source files after cutover were migration comments, not live imports — tsc clean is the authoritative check for SC#5 'zero references'.
Core test count dropped 228→190 (−38) after cutover: −17 `folder-metadata.test.ts` + −21 `file-ipns.test.ts`, both justified by deleted `folder/` and `file/` directories.
Nyquist validation gate requires a `## Validation Architecture` section in RESEARCH.md to generate VALIDATION.md; without research, plans lack Dimension-8 validation requirements.
The `schema-gate` plan:pre hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM); Phase 62 touches only `packages/core` crypto codec — DB schema lives in `apps/api` (Phase 66 scope).
API surface intel (`gsd-tools query intel`) extracted 0 symbols for this phase — HINT-only file with no planner value; safe to omit from planner prompt.

drift precheck (`action_required: warn`, `spawn_mapper: false`) was non-blocking; it flagged 143 pre-existing elements (stale baseline map from Feb `.learnings/`, `landing/`, root configs), none specific to Phase 62.
Vault v3 blob format: `0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey)` — two-key, replaces v2's single `encryptedRootFolderKey`.
Phase 62 `workflow.branching_strategy=phase`; branch `feat/unified-node-codec-core-keystone` already existed and was reused as-is (no switch needed).
Plan 08 exceeded the per-plan file threshold (~43 files) and had to be split into 08a (web logic, wave 6) and 08b (web components + final root `pnpm typecheck`, wave 7) during the revision round.

code.finding: Frozen golden vector file for the Node wire format: body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock. Uses Phase-61 node_id/IV so Phase-69 Rust cross-language test can slot in without vector regeneration.
Committed cross-language vector for the vault v3 blob (two-key ECIES layout); required to be in `tests/vectors/`, not inline in plan or test file, for D-04 cross-language parity.
Implements `sealNode`/`unsealNode` by composing Phase-61 primitives `sealAesGcmAad`/`buildNodeAad`. Freeze-first milestone — must land before any consumer seals.
Barrel cutover in 62-05: drops `./folder` and `./file` exports, adds `./node`. Deleting the directory removes 7 files; the barrel edit is the structural keystone.

workflow: Worktree isolation was skipped in favor of sequential execution: pnpm monorepos lack `node_modules` in worktrees (slow per-worktree install), and the cross-package dist chain (core→sdk-core→sdk→web) is far simpler on one tree.
`gsd tools query commit` can report `commit_failed` even when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log` before retrying or concluding failure.
PATTERNS.md written by the pattern-mapper subagent is not auto-committed by step 13d (known gap); must be committed explicitly before spawning the planner.

Plan-checker revision loop (1 round): blocker was RESEARCH.md missing `(RESOLVED)` markers; warnings included exit-code-masking in tsc verifies (`echo` trailing), insufficient web test quarantine scope discovery (grep-based fix), and oversized plan 08.

`workflow.auto_advance: true` in config would normally chain into execute-phase automatically; the orchestrator deliberately stopped at 'planned' for an unsupervised v2.0 keystone until user confirmed, then proceeded with `--no-transition` to prevent chaining into Phase 63.

friction: `gsd tools query commit` reported `commit_failed` for VALIDATION.md but `git log` confirmed it landed (`2475ae35d`) — false-negative caused unnecessary investigation.
Node eval for worktree-degrade logic had a quoting bug in bash, requiring a manual re-extraction and explicit decision.
Requirements-coverage display loop had a word-splitting glitch (printed all 6 IDs as one token); required a clean re-run to produce a trustworthy result.
drift precheck emitted a wall of 143 pre-existing file names as its 'message', requiring an extra extraction step to confirm it was a stale map (not phase-specific) and non-blocking.
Executor agent (62-04 docs plan) encountered the same `query commit` false-negative and had to self-verify via git log — same known issue surfacing at subagent level.
